name: DiversiFi Guardian
description: FX-risk intelligence with a constrained agent. You set the rules, the Guardian operates within them, and every decision is explainable and verifiable: data → deterministic risk calculation → constrained strategy → AI explanation → user approval → on-chain execution. By default the Guardian only proposes moves the user signs in their own wallet; autonomous execution exists only under a user-signed ERC-7715 permission enforced on-chain by the user's own smart account (Celo, Celo Sepolia, Arbitrum). No custody. Serves emerging-market savers protecting purchasing power and businesses that earn in one currency and pay in another (per-cycle FX drag). Values-aligned plans (Africapitalism, Buen Vivir, Confucian, Gotong Royong, Islamic Finance, Pan-Caribbean, Global Diversification, Custom). Every decision is recorded on the chain-aware RecommendationLedger and anchored to 0G Storage; read-only intelligence is also exposed as MCP tools.
